# Command Cheat Sheet

Essential daily commands for developing, building, and operating Nix and NixOS systems.

## Flake and Development Commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `nix develop` | Enter the default project development shell |
| `nix develop .#backend` | Enter a specific named development shell |
| `nix flake init -t <template>` | Initialize a project from a flake template |
| `nix flake check` | Run all checks, tests, and linters defined in the flake |
| `nix flake update` | Update all inputs in `flake.lock` to latest upstream revisions |
| `nix flake update <input>` | Update a single specific input (e.g. `nixpkgs`) |
| `nix flake show` | Display all packages, devShells, and modules in the flake |

## Building and Querying

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `nix build .#package` | Build a flake package and link to `./result` |
| `nix run .#app` | Build and immediately execute a flake application |
| `nix eval .#attribute` | Evaluate a Nix expression and print the value |
| `nix log ./result` | Display the build log for an artifact or derivation |
| `nix path-info -rsh ./result` | Show the closure size and disk footprint of an artifact |
| `nix-tree ./result` | Interactively browse the dependency tree |

## NixOS Operations

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `sudo nixos-rebuild switch --flake .#host` | Build, activate, and set as default boot generation |
| `sudo nixos-rebuild test --flake .#host` | Test configuration in the current session without updating bootloader |
| `sudo nixos-rebuild dry-activate --flake .#host` | Preview which services will restart without making changes |
| `sudo nixos-rebuild switch --rollback` | Instantly revert to the previous working generation |
| `nixos-rebuild list-generations` | List all historical system generations |

## Maintenance and Disk Cleanup

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `nix-store --optimise` | Hard-link duplicate files across the store to save disk space |
| `nix-collect-garbage` | Delete unreferenced store paths |
| `nix-collect-garbage -d` | Delete all old generations and unreferenced store paths |
| `nix-collect-garbage --delete-older-than 30d` | Delete generations older than 30 days |
